verdict.rationale: Pigment's finance use-case page says data is 'easily integrated through native connectors, open APIs, and scheduled imports', and it has an HR/workforce use case. This suggests headcount data could flow into the same planning platform as the books. No evidence names specific payroll/HRIS or CRM connectors or shows pipeline data landing in a shared model. The Agent Connectors (Notion, Drive, Slack) serve agent context and do not count as data ingestion here. Missing for 10: named HRIS/payroll connectors, named CRM connectors, documentation of headcount and pipeline data mapping into the same model as the GL, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, payroll/HRIS and CRM connectors bring headcount and pipeline data into the same model as the books

citations.quote: easily integrated through native connectors, open APIs, and scheduled imports.
